title: File Path Mention Inconsistency in VSCode Claude Extension
body:
**Bug Description**
when using @ to mention files, the results are erratic, like if it ignores some paths. Using claude in vscode.\
still love the product but the new bug is frustrating :(

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: vscode
- Version: 1.0.29
- Feedback ID: afe5fb7f-57f4-40cc-a79c-3af0f8e9be5d
